airplane: Airplanes appear as elongated metallic objects with distinct fuselage, wings, and tail, parked on hardstand areas or taxiways. They differ from airports by being discrete aircraft rather than the entire aviation facility; runways show linear pavement without aircraft shape; parking lots show vehicle rows without any aircraft structures.
airport: Airports show long, straight runways with distinct markings, connected to large terminal buildings, hangars, and aircraft parking stands. They differ from runways by including terminal buildings and parking areas rather than just pavement; industrial areas show factories and smokestacks rather than aviation infrastructure; railway stations show train tracks and platforms rather than runways.
baseball_diamond: Baseball diamonds show diamond-shaped infields with visible pitcher's mound, baselines, outfield grass, and surrounding fences. They differ from golf courses by having sports diamond geometry rather than fairways and bunkers; stadiums have large surrounding stands; ground track fields show oval running tracks rather than diamond infields.
basketball_court: Basketball courts show rectangular paved areas with clear court markings, center circle, and key areas. They differ from tennis courts by having different court markings without nets; parking lots show vehicle rows rather than court markings; mobile home parks show trailer units rather than sports courts.
beach: Beaches appear as sandy or pebbly shorelines along water bodies, with light colors and wave patterns. They contrast with islands by being coastal shorelines rather than land surrounded by water; deserts show inland sand without water adjacency; sea ice shows frozen white surfaces rather than sandy shores.
bridge: Bridges show elevated roadway or railway structures spanning over water or valleys, with visible pillars and deck. They differ from rivers by being man-made structures crossing over water; freeways are ground-level corridors without span structures; railways show ground-level tracks rather than elevated crossings.
chaparral: Chaparral appears as dense, low, dark-green shrub vegetation with irregular edges covering hillsides. It contrasts with deserts by having dense vegetation rather than sand dunes; forests have taller tree canopy rather than low shrubs; mountains show exposed rock and elevation rather than uniform shrub cover.
church: Churches show distinctive religious architecture with prominent spires, steeples, or domes, often with a central nave. They differ from palaces by having religious spires rather than ornate palace architecture; commercial areas show retail buildings rather than churches; medium residential shows housing units without religious structures.
circular_farmland: Circular farmland shows large pivot-irrigated fields with concentric circular patterns and visible center-pivot systems. It differs from rectangular farmland by having circular geometry rather than straight field boundaries; storage tanks show metallic circular containers rather than crop circles; terraces show stepped agricultural patterns on slopes.
cloud: Clouds appear as bright white to gray irregular masses with soft edges and diffuse boundaries in the sky. They differ from mountains by lacking solid ground and elevation contours; sea ice shows frozen surface patterns; snowberg shows snow-covered peaks rather than atmospheric formations.
commercial_area: Commercial areas show dense retail and office buildings with large parking lots and visible storefronts. They contrast with industrial areas by having retail stores rather than warehouses and smokestacks; palaces show ornate architecture rather than commercial blocks; dense residential shows housing units rather than commercial buildings.
dense_residential: Dense residential features tightly packed housing units with small yards, narrow streets, and uniform block patterns. It differs from medium residential by having smaller lot sizes and less green space; mobile home parks show narrow trailer units rather than houses; commercial areas show retail buildings rather than residences.
desert: Deserts show vast, barren landscapes with sand dunes, rocky outcrops, and sparse dry vegetation. They contrast with chaparral by lacking dense shrub vegetation; mountains show elevated rocky peaks; beaches show coastal sandy areas adjacent to water.
forest: Forests show dense tree canopy with dark green textures, irregular edges, and no visible ground. They contrast with chaparral by having taller trees rather than low shrubs; meadows show open grassy areas without tree cover; wetlands show water-saturated ground rather than dense canopy.
freeway: Freeways are wide linear strips of paved concrete with multiple lanes, clear lane markings, and overpass intersections. They differ from overpasses by being ground-level pavement rather than elevated structures; runways are shorter and lack lane divisions; railways show metal tracks rather than paved vehicle lanes.
golf_course: Golf courses are large green areas with mowed fairways, lighter roughs, sand bunkers, and small water hazards. They contrast with baseball diamonds by having fairways and bunkers rather than sports infields; meadows show natural grass without maintained features; rectangular farmland shows crop rows rather than fairways.
ground_track_field: Ground track fields show oval running tracks with distinct lane markings, infield areas, and surrounding stands. They differ from stadiums by being track-focused fields rather than large enclosed sports venues; baseball diamonds have diamond infields rather than oval tracks; railways show linear tracks rather than oval circuits.
harbor: Harbors show calm water areas enclosed by docks, piers, ships, and cranes. They differ from ships by being entire waterfront facilities rather than individual vessels; parking lots have vehicles rather than ships; beaches show natural sand without port infrastructure.
industrial_area: Industrial areas feature large warehouses, factories, smokestacks, and extensive parking lots. They differ from thermal power stations by having diverse factories rather than power generation; storage tanks show circular metallic containers rather than factory buildings; commercial areas show retail rather than industrial structures.
intersection: Intersections show cross-shaped road junctions with clear pavement markings and turn lanes. They contrast with roundabouts by having perpendicular crossing geometry rather than circular flow; freeways are continuous corridors rather than local junctions; parking lots show vehicle storage rather than road crossings.
island: Islands show land masses completely surrounded by water, with visible shorelines and vegetation or structures. They differ from beaches by being entire landforms rather than shoreline strips; rivers show flowing water channels rather than land; sea ice shows frozen surfaces rather than solid land.
lake: Lakes appear as large, enclosed water bodies with smooth surfaces and irregular shorelines. They contrast with wetlands by having open water rather than water-saturated ground; sea ice shows frozen surfaces rather than open water; rivers show flowing channels rather than still water bodies.
meadow: Meadows show open, grassy areas with smooth texture, often with scattered trees, and no field lines. They contrast with forests by having open grass rather than dense canopy; rectangular farmland shows organized crop rows; golf courses have maintained fairways and bunkers rather than natural grass.
medium_residential: Medium residential shows moderately sized houses on medium lots with visible yards and tree-lined streets. It differs from dense residential by having larger lots; sparse residential shows wider spacing; mobile home parks show trailer units rather than permanent houses.
mobile_home_park: Mobile home parks show rows of small, narrow rectangular trailer units arranged in dense, uniform clusters. They contrast with medium residential by having trailer units rather than permanent houses; dense residential shows permanent housing; storage tanks show metallic containers rather than trailer units.
mountain: Mountains show elevated, rugged terrain with steep slopes, rocky outcrops, and shadow patterns. They contrast with deserts by having rocky peaks rather than sand dunes; snowberg shows snow-capped peaks; forests show tree cover without dramatic elevation.
overpass: Overpasses are elevated road segments supported by pillars, crossing above other roads or terrain. They differ from freeways by being raised structures rather than ground-level pavement; bridges span over water rather than land; railways show ground-level tracks rather than elevated roads.
palace: Palaces show ornate, large-scale architecture with grand courtyards and gardens. They differ from churches by lacking religious spires; commercial areas show modern retail buildings; tennis courts show sports facilities rather than palace grounds.
parking_lot: Parking lots are flat, paved areas with visible rows of parked vehicles in organized lanes. They contrast with harbors by having vehicles rather than ships; industrial areas have buildings alongside parking; airports show runways and aircraft rather than just vehicle storage.
railway: Railways show linear track corridors with parallel metal rails, ties, and occasional signals. They differ from railway stations by being track corridors rather than full station facilities; freeways show paved vehicle lanes rather than metal rails; bridges are elevated crossing structures.
railway_station: Railway stations show tracks, platforms, passenger buildings, and surrounding parking lots. They contrast with industrial areas by having passenger platforms rather than factories; airports have runways and terminals rather than train tracks; viaducts show elevated rail structures rather than ground-level stations.
rectangular_farmland: Rectangular farmland shows large agricultural fields with straight, geometric boundaries and uniform crop rows. It differs from circular farmland by having rectangular geometry; terraces show stepped patterns on slopes; meadows show natural grass without crop rows.
river: Rivers appear as narrow, sinuous, dark water channels with flowing patterns and riparian vegetation. They contrast with lakes by being elongated flowing water rather than still water bodies; wetlands show saturated ground rather than flowing channels; bridges are structures spanning rivers.
roundabout: Roundabouts show circular road junctions with a central island and circulating lanes. They differ from intersections by having circular flow rather than perpendicular crossing; parking lots show vehicle storage rather than road circles; overpasses show elevated structures rather than ground-level circles.
runway: Runways are long, straight, wide paved strips with clear parallel markings and end zones. They contrast with freeways by being shorter with aircraft markings; airports show terminal buildings alongside runways; parking lots show vehicle rows rather than runway pavement.
sea_ice: Sea ice appears as vast, white to light blue frozen surfaces with irregular cracks and floes. It differs from lakes by being frozen rather than open water; snowberg shows snow on land rather than sea ice; beaches show sandy shorelines rather than frozen surfaces.
ship: Ships appear as large watercraft with distinct hulls, superstructures, and decks. They differ from harbors by being individual vessels rather than waterfront facilities; islands show solid land rather than watercraft; sea ice shows frozen surfaces without vessels.
snowberg: Snowbergs show mountain peaks covered with white snow, with exposed rock faces and ridge lines. They differ from mountains by having snow cover rather than exposed rock; sea ice shows flat frozen surfaces rather than peaks; clouds show soft atmospheric formations rather than solid peaks.
sparse_residential: Sparse residential shows widely separated houses surrounded by large vegetated lots. It contrasts with medium residential by having larger lot sizes; forests show tree cover without housing; rectangular farmland shows agricultural fields rather than houses.
stadium: Stadiums show large sports venues with oval or rectangular shape, tiered seating, and surrounding parking. They contrast with ground track fields by having enclosed stands; baseball diamonds have sports field markings without stands; playgrounds are much smaller recreational areas.
storage_tank: Storage tanks appear as large circular metallic containers with domed or flat roofs. They differ from thermal power stations by being tank clusters rather than power generation facilities; circular farmland shows crop patterns rather than metallic containers; industrial areas show factories rather than tank farms.
tennis_court: Tennis courts are rectangular playing areas with visible nets, court lines, and smooth surfaces. They differ from basketball courts by having nets and different markings; parking lots show vehicle rows rather than court surfaces; mobile home parks show trailer units rather than sports courts.
terrace: Terraces show stepped agricultural or landscape patterns on slopes with visible contour lines. They differ from rectangular farmland by having stepped geometry on slopes; circular farmland shows pivot irrigation patterns; ground track fields show oval running tracks rather than terraced slopes.
thermal_power_station: Thermal power stations show large cooling towers, steam plumes, and industrial buildings. They differ from storage tanks by having cooling towers rather than tank clusters; industrial areas show diverse factories; commercial areas show retail buildings rather than power plants.
wetland: Wetlands show water-saturated ground with emergent vegetation and marshy textures. They contrast with lakes by having marsh vegetation rather than open water; rivers show flowing channels rather than saturated ground; meadows show dry grass without water saturation.
